papers.title: An algorithmic construction of Nullstellensatz certificates for graph automorphism groups
papers.abstract: Solvers for graph isomorphism and related problems are widely used in both theoretical and applied domains, but their complexity often requires users to trust their correctness without verification. We present a certifying algorithm for computing a generating set of the automorphism group of a given graph, meaning that it produces an independently verifiable certificate that the output list of automorphisms generates the entirety of the automorphism group. The problem of constructing a certificate is reduced to certifying that a system of multivariate polynomial equations is infeasible. An individualization-refinement algorithm produces a derivation within an algebraic proof system, representing a Nullstellensatz certificate of infeasibility. We provide an implementation of both the certifying algorithm and a certificate verifier, and demonstrate their viability on graphs with hundreds of vertices.
